offerings.name: Tavily Search (basic, fast, ultra-fast)
offerings.pricing: Pay-as-you-go: $0.008 per credit; basic, fast, ultra-fast: 1 API Credit per request. Monthly plans: $0.0075 - $0.005 per credit.
offerings.free_quota: You get 1,000 free API Credits every month. No credit card required.
offerings.output_type: 按相关性排序的结构化搜索结果，含标题、来源URL和内容片段；可选LLM答案、图片及原始内容
offerings.note: basic为默认深度；默认最多返回10条结果，可设置为0至20条。

offerings.name: Tavily Search (advanced)
offerings.pricing: Pay-as-you-go: $0.008 per credit; advanced: 2 API Credits per request. Monthly plans: $0.0075 - $0.005 per credit.
offerings.free_quota: You get 1,000 free API Credits every month. No credit card required.
offerings.output_type: 按相关性排序的结构化搜索结果，每个URL可返回多个语义相关片段；可选更详细的LLM答案
offerings.note: advanced提供最高相关性但延迟增加；每个来源可配置1至3个内容片段。
